register.name: PCI_SPCIE_CAP_HEADER_REG
register.comment: SPCIE Capability Header. This Register provides Capability Id, Capability Version, and next Offset of SPCIE Structure.

register.name: PCI_LINK_CONTROL3_REG
register.comment: Link Control 3 Register. This Register controls equilization and equilization interrupt.

register.name: PCI_LANE_ERR_STATUS_REG
register.comment: Lane Error Status Register. This Register contains Lane Error Status Bits per Lane.

register.name: PCI_SPCIE_CAP_OFF_0CH_REG
register.comment: Lane Equalization Control Register for lanes 1 and 0. This register provides Transmitter Preset and Receiver Preset Hint for Downstream Port and Upstream Port.
